shots.text: People who fled before we reached their towns came up the roads to Solenne. We gave them the squares, then the gardens, then the halls of my palace.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Solenne's streets packed with refugees from different lands, tents in the white squares, the Sunstone glowing gold above.

shots.text: The Lord Marshal Cassivane commanded our armies. He met every cart at the gate himself. Six years after he lost his daughter, he still wore her picture in a gold locket.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Cassivane Dral at the gate, red cloak, helping an old woman off a cart, smiling. Fennick beside him grumbling over a tower plan.

shots.text: You are winning, Spirewright. Every life we lose out there will be paid back. I promise you that.
shots.speaker: cassivane
shots.art_note: Cassivane looking straight at the player, warm, fatherly. As he turns away, his thumb runs over the gold locket.

shots.text: Six years before, my half-brother Corvin had called him a traitor. Then Corvin was found over a dead man, and I exiled him. I believed Cassivane.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Night: Cassivane alone on the Spire of Aurel, looking east toward the Rift. The locket open in his hand. A girl's portrait inside.
